evals.prompt: I just wrote a new SKILL.md for a project and the description field is 3 paragraphs long, explaining in detail what it does. Is that a problem?
evals.expected_output: Correctly flags this as a problem: the description is always-loaded metadata paid on every turn, should be specific but concise, and 1024-char/conciseness guidance applies. Recommends moving extended explanation into the body or a reference file, and gives concrete guidance on what should stay in the description (what + when) vs. move out.
expectations: Flags the 3-paragraph description as a real problem, not a stylistic nicety
Explains that the description is always-loaded/permanent context cost paid on every turn
Recommends moving detail into the body or a reference file rather than the description
Gives concrete guidance on what belongs in a description (what + when) vs. what should move out
